experimental_method: PVT cylinder (300 mL hastelloy) with water displacement: at constant gas pressure part of the equilibrated water is transferred out, flashed at ambient conditions and the released gas and water volumes are measured.
uncertainties_stated: u(T) = 0.05 K, u(p) = 0.01 MPa; volume measurement accuracy 0.01 mL; no uncertainty on s stated; measurements repeated at least twice per point.
quality_remarks: (1) Unit question: s x 10^3 is labelled 'mol %'; for CH4 at 293.2 K and 21 MPa the printed 3.289 matches the usual mole fraction x = 3.3e-3 (0.33 mol %), so the printed unit label may be wrong by a factor of 100 (value as printed read as mol % would be 3.3e-5 fraction). Resolved in the mapping: the label is judged a mislabel and the number is used as a mole fraction x 1e-3. (2) Table 5 block header 289.15 K versus 289.45 K elsewhere (probable misprint; mapping uses 289.45 K, supported by Table 3 and Table 6). (3) Only the gas mixture CH4/C2H6 95/5 feed composition is given; composition of dissolved gas not reported. (4) Average relative error versus literature CH4 is 4.10 % (authors).
